title: Lifecycle event (one line of storyline/work/<slug>/events.jsonl)
description: The typed, append-only transition event. Every write through ./scripts/storyline or ./scripts/kit tracker-fold appends exactly one line; the same shape becomes an storyline_events Record (kit/tracker/field-map.yaml maps the keys). Nothing ever rewrites or deletes a line: storyline.yml fails a PR that changes an existing line. `actor` is always a role, never a person or an email; the approver's email stays in the Record's actor_ref inside the tenant and never reaches git. Enums for phases and gates come from storyline/lifecycle/state-machine.yaml (checked by phase_enum_in_sync). Spec: REPO-DESIGN.md §6.5; the catalogue of who writes which event is storyline/observability/README.md.

ts.description: UTC, always with Z (Records drop offsets)

decision.description: Depends on event_type. gate_decision: a decision word from state-machine.yaml gate_info.<gate>.decisions. transition: that decision word; the check that moved the row (intake_complete, discovery_complete, build_evidence, improve_trigger, change_needed, retire_candidate, retro_closed); pending_merge for the G2 or G4 move written on the branch before the merge; intake or seeded for a new row. specialist_run: started / finished, proposed, or the crew member's verdict (done, changes_requested, blocked, pass). escalation: opened (GX). budget: park (GB). sync: folded, apply_config, pending (a G5 request not decided yet). conflict: kept_git, tracker_drift. Null when none applies

actor.description: A role (story owner role, a GitHub team slug, a crew member's name, a script or workflow name) — never a person, never an email

actor_kind.description: human = a person's decision · agent = a crew member's applied output · ci = deterministic code (a workflow, or a ./scripts/storyline step such as verify-merge or a check) · story = the Tines story ([KIT] 00 sections B–E)

agent.description: The crew member (IDE or Tines-side) or script that ran; null when none did

model_tier.description: strong|standard|fast for IDE crew; fast|smart for Tines-side agents (the tenant defaults)

model_reported.description: The model as the client or the AI Agent event metadata shows it; never a hard-coded id

credits_used.description: Tines AI credits for a Tines-side run; null for IDE crew (they spend the editor's plan)

refs.description: Repo paths, PR numbers (#n), change-request ids, Record ids — never a URL carrying a secret

tracker_rev.description: The row's rev this event produces or was recorded at (storyline/GLOSSARY.md, rev)

sha.description: The commit the event is about (a build, a merge, a ship), or null
